governancePolicy.truthfulnessMandate: Every bookable or inquiry-based experience uses a verified product photo, a clearly appropriate destination-activity photo, or an honest designed placeholder — never an unrelated tour, wrong operator vehicle/vessel/aircraft, or AI-generated experience photo.
governancePolicy.aiImageryBoundary: AI-generated images are prohibited for operators, vehicles, aircraft, vessels, venues, or bookable experiences.
